description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests to configure WPS and WiFi SSID settings on a device. It processes JSON configuration data, applies settings such as enabling/disabling WPS, selecting WPS methods, pairing clients via push button or PIN, and cancels sessions. The script interacts with device configuration via setStr commands and manages multiple SSIDs.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies configuration to a specific SSID by setting apply flags for the WiFi radio corresponding to the SSID.
